name: Frost Legion
description: (Tag:golem)(Tag:group)(Tag:ice)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)This summons the Frost Legion, a horde of murder-happy gangster snowmen wielding hardened ice knives, tommy guns, ice grenades, and similar weapons. Summonable numbers depend on maximum energy with a minimum of 50, 1 killed snowman recovers every 1 hour, and frost or ice affinity strengthens them.
